property.name: Marigold Bay Hotel
property.tagline: A 48-room boutique hotel on the Goa coastline
property.address: 12 Coconut Grove Road, Candolim, Goa 403515, India

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.beds: 1 king bed and 2 single beds in a second bedroom

amenities.name: Swimming pool
amenities.description: Outdoor infinity pool overlooking the bay, 25 metres long, with a shallow children's section.

amenities.name: Breakfast
amenities.description: Buffet breakfast at the Saffron restaurant with Indian and continental options. Included for Deluxe King, Junior Suite and Family Suite. Available as an add-on for Standard Double and Twin Room.
amenities.cost: INR 650 per person per day when not included

amenities.name: Fitness centre
amenities.description: Small gym with treadmills, free weights and a rowing machine.

amenities.name: Spa
amenities.description: Two treatment rooms offering Ayurvedic massages. Booking required at reception.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.description: On-site parking for 20 cars, first come first served.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.description: Free high-speed Wi-Fi in all rooms and public areas.

amenities.name: Airport shuttle
amenities.description: Shared shuttle to and from Goa International Airport (Dabolim), about 45 minutes. Book at least 24 hours ahead.

amenities.name: Restaurant and bar
amenities.description: Saffron serves lunch and dinner; the Tide Bar on the pool deck serves drinks and snacks.
amenities.hours: Saffron 12:30 to 15:00 and 19:00 to 22:30; Tide Bar 11:00 to 23:00

policies.text: Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is by 11:00. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may carry a charge of INR 1500. A government-issued photo ID is required for all adult guests at check-in.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the check-in date. Cancellations within 48 hours, or no-shows, are charged the first night. Non-refundable rates, where booked, cannot be cancelled or changed.
Children under 6 stay free when sharing existing beds. One extra bed can be added to Deluxe King and Junior Suite for INR 1500 per night. Cribs are free on request.
Pets are not allowed, with the exception of certified assistance animals.
All rooms are non-smoking. A designated smoking area is available on the pool deck. A cleaning fee of INR 5000 applies for smoking in rooms.
We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UPI and cash in INR. A refundable security deposit of INR 5000 is held at check-in.
Two Standard Double rooms on the ground floor are wheelchair accessible with roll-in showers. The pool deck and restaurant are step-free.

faqs.question: How far is the hotel from the beach?
faqs.answer: Candolim Beach is a 4-minute walk through the garden gate.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum stay?
faqs.answer: A two-night minimum applies between 20 December and 5 January. There is no minimum stay at other times.

faqs.question: Do you offer room service?
faqs.answer: Room service is available from 07:00 to 23:00 from the Saffron menu.

faqs.question: Can I store luggage before check-in or after check-out?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary luggage storage is available at reception on the day of arrival and departure.

faqs.question: Do rooms have a kitchen?
faqs.answer: Only the Family Suite has a kitchenette with a microwave, fridge and induction hob. All rooms have a tea and coffee maker.
